method: Extracted source archive into an empty directory, configured and compiled without old build cache, ran CTest and Python tests. Replayed all saved frames using the newly built executable.
limits: Reused installed MSVC, OpenCV5 and actual RKNN header; vendor binaries are not in the source package.
Python tests use the existing cv2 4.13.0 environment.
Full ONNX CPU comparison passed in source round19; source package contains no model weights.
No ARM cross build, Linux real engine process, real NPU or motor acceptance.
